summary: Build advanced hotel pricing and forecasting skills with practical tools, dashboards, and strategy exercises. Enrol now.
lede: Hotel revenue management uses demand, inventory, and pricing data to guide room-selling decisions. For professionals responsible for pricing, occupancy, inventory controls, and performance reporting, the course covers booking-pace analysis, demand forecasting, rate fences, channel mix, and overbooking controls. It also addresses KPI dashboards and communicating forecast assumptions and revenue actions with sales and operations.
audienceIntro: This advanced hotel revenue management course is for professionals who already work with pricing, occupancy, inventory controls, and performance reporting, and now need sharper commercial judgment. It is written for people responsible for daily room revenue decisions, forecast updates, and cross-functional communication in real hotel environments.
audience: Director of Sales and Marketing leaders
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: advanced working knowledge of hotel operations, room inventory, pricing terminology, and basic revenue KPIs such as ADR and RevPAR. You should already understand PMS workflows, distribution channels, and standard hotel forecasting concepts. Coding/programming: not required. The course uses spreadsheet-based analysis, hotel KPI dashboards, and practical planning templates. Advanced concepts depth: conceptual awareness for AI-assisted forecasting and RMS logic, operational application for forecasting, pricing, and distribution control, and hands-on implementation for dashboards, comp-set analysis, and revenue action plans.
